correctness.rationale: Explicit nonempty face enumeration in five finite 8–16-vertex Möbius ladders, full vertex-toggle matching reproduction, and whole Hasse-digraph topological sorting verify acyclicity with one critical zero-cell and only d-cells for d>=2. Discrete Morse CW construction therefore gives integral sphere wedges; independently forbidden-triple enumeration and mod-two boundary ranks corroborate, with signed Lefschetz computations yielding complete rational dihedral traces. The finite claims have no extrapolation.

value.rationale: The five named highly symmetric cubic graphs form a motivated first complete modulo-four parameter cycle and first repetition, directly informed by the new 2026 ordinary-independence periodicity theorem. Exact integral sphere-wedge homotopy types and complete dihedral characters go beyond elementary face counts, illustrate a nine-versus-eleven wedge-rank change under twisting at ten vertices, and supply valuable benchmarks for nonchordal higher-independence topology without asserting a larger unproved theorem.
